blocks.text: Acyl chlorides have the functional group -COCl. Saturated aliphatic acyl chlorides have the general formula CnH2n+1COCl and are named in the IUPAC system as alkanoyl halides, e.g. ethanoyl chloride, CH3COCl, and propanoyl chloride, CH3CH2COCl. Acyl chlorides are the most reactive of the functional derivatives of carboxylic acids, so they are usually used to make other derivatives.
